body.name: Episode 8
body.summary: A child suffers a life-changing medical event, a man dislocates his ankle on a remote track, and a woman falls headfirst off a horse.

show.name: First Responders
show.summary: New Zealand averages 870,000 calls for urgent help every year. This series takes viewers out on rescue helicopters, ambulances & boats with emergency teams as they attend to desperate situations.

show.name: Избранный
show.summary: A modest employee of the research institute, Oleg Tyapin, is unexpectedly elected to the Duma of the new convocation. He doesn't want to be a deputy at all, but duty is duty - Tyapin leaves provincial Glebov for Moscow to take on new responsibilities. The hero will go through all the stages of development and formation of himself as a new person, fall in love, and most importantly, experience a lot of comical situations.

show.name: История его служанки
show.summary:
Moscow, 19th century. Lush balls, the glamour of estates, and behind-the-scenes intrigues. The young and eligible bachelor Count Nikolai Sheremetyev returns to the world of high society after the war. His arrival ignites the social circles, as mothers and daughters plot to secure a wealthy husband. However, things become more complicated for Nikolai, as his mother's will requires him to marry within a year, or he will lose his inheritance. Meanwhile, the Averin family finds themselves on the brink of ruin due to the family's gambling debts. Their daughter, Anna, a stubborn and witty noblewoman, decides to meet the count personally, hoping he will forgive their debt.

 Sheremetyev, a man of principles, offers a deal: a year of Anna's service at his estate. Thus, Anna becomes the count's most unusual servant. As she adjusts to her new role, various suitors arrive at Nikolai's home. However, the more time they spend together, the more difficult it becomes to conceal their mutual attraction. In the meantime, the stories unfold between Anna's younger brother, Roma, and the daughter of wealthy neighbors, Yulia, as well as between Elena and Averin, a couple whose marriage teeters on the brink of collapse but still holds a flickering spark.

show.name: Swallowed Star
show.summary: One day, an unexplained RR virus appeared on the earth, drawing the world into disaster. Infected animals mutated into terrible monsters, invaded massively, and humans built walls around the destruction and established the base city as the last bastion for humans. The suffering that mankind has experienced during this period of time is known as the "Great Nirvana Period." Not only that, Luo Feng not only carried the burden of supporting the family but also to protect the human homeland, for the better survival and development of mankind, together with other justice warriors, to join hands against the fierce monsters. Under the desperate situation of the end, can Luo Feng and other warriors repel monsters and successfully protect the human world?

show.name: Wan Jie Du Zun
show.summary: Lin Feng was gathering his martial soul in the Lin Mansion. He didn't want to. His fiancee Ji Manyao took the opportunity to take his martial soul, and he almost vomited blood and died. At the same time, Lin Feng's spirit entered the land of the burial of the gods. The mysterious woman in the land of the burials told Lin Feng that he could gain enormous martial arts power and knowledge by obliterating the ancient gods buried here.

show.name: Shrouding the Heavens
show.summary: The story took the nine dragons and the coffin as an introduction and brought out a huge world of primeval ages. Climbing the sky road, and singing songs, to see how Ye Fan shrouding the heavens.

show.name: Summer Vacation
show.summary: Kim Ha Yeon is an ordinary 18-year-old girl who dreams of a life as dramatic as the ones she sees on screen. Her life takes an unexpected, mystical turn when she heads to the unfamiliar countryside village of Upo-ri for her summer break. There, she crosses paths with Jo Yu Gyeom, the heir to a traditional noble family, and his girlfriend, Sae Ryeong. While he possesses stunning looks and a genius talent for swimming, he lives a colorless existence constrained by old-fashioned rules and repetitive routines. As these two opposites meet in the quiet beauty of Upo-ri, their worlds collide, sparking a transformation in their daily lives and the beginning of a once-in-a-lifetime summer.

show.name: Let's Go
show.summary: During the Republic of China era, Wang Laowu, a veterinarian by trade, accidentally becomes the county magistrate of Fuhu County. Once in office, he encounters endless troubles and fights his way through every obstacle in this absurd, comic tale. Centering on ordinary people, the drama reveals how small characters forge a grand era in Republican China.

show.name: Blossom in Darkness
show.summary: The play is adapted based on Guoguo's novel of the same name. Big Demon Qi Fengyin (acted by Li Hongyi), born out of evil thoughts, is locked in the Panic Mountain Barrier due to his killing of the mortals and immortals a thousand years ago. The small Medicine Spirit Yamao (acted by Sun Zhenni), transformed from the herb Huanyangcao, is chased by all sorts of people due to its magic physique and happens to break in the barrier, leading Qi Fengyin's failure to have a human body and his evil thoughts fly. Since then, the two have had a deep bond and have experienced all kinds of stories together.

show.name: Sunshine Through The Rain
show.summary: This is the story of the headstrong girl Zheng Yu and the lonely boy Chen Yan Zhou. Burdened by her family's poverty, Zheng Yu must take on heavy responsibilities, while Chen Yan Zhou withdraws into himself after the death of his older brother. From school rivals, they gradually become a light in each other's lives, facing life's storms together.

show.name: GuAn
show.summary: In the darkest moment of Celestial Realm, the crippled youth Gu An seized the power of an ancient god amid life-or-death peril. Wielding infinite spiritual energy and a mortal blade, he destroyed evildoers, avenged deep grudges, and struck down the heavens.

show.name: Vow of Autumn
show.summary: Deceived by a married jerk, lawyer Wen Wanqing gets drunk and accidentally kisses her best friend's younger brother, surgeon Pei Yiqiu—who has secretly loved her for years. As misunderstandings give way to romance, she breaks free from her toxic relationship, while he offers the tenderness she's always deserved. A two-way journey that began in their youth finally comes full circle, bringing them both a chance to heal.

show.name: Rise of the Underdog
show.summary: Ma Dawei's previous life ends in prison and family ruin, but he suddenly returns to the turning point of his fate. He resolutely avoids the pitfalls, grasps the opportunities of the age, and rises with momentum. Against one scheme after another, Ma Dawei cuts off old entanglements, protects his loved ones with all his strength, sails through the ups and downs of business, and sets off toward a brilliant new future that belongs to him.

body.summary: A decision threatens to derail what Suki and Eve have been fighting for. Celebrations take an unexpected turn when some surprising news sends emotions running high. Gina and Penny search for answers.

show.name: EastEnders
show.summary:
Set in the East End of London, the show focuses on the tensions between love and family with stories ranging from hard-hitting social issues, to personal, human tragedies. And there's plenty of funny moments too. 

Classic characters old and new across thousands of episodes have shared a drink in The Queen Vic, shed tears of despair or joy, sat on Arthur's bench in the Square... and at some point or other they probably crossed paths with Ian Beale.

show.name: Love Island Australia
show.summary:
Taking the hottest international reality show format right now and unleashing it on 9GO!, the multi-million-dollar stripped format commission, Love Island Australia, will see sexy young Aussie singles on the lookout for romance, jetting off to a summer paradise to find love in the sun in Spain.

Not only must they must choose their partner wisely and stay the course as sexy new singles enter the island, but they also must win the hearts of the public, convincing them – and themselves – that their newfound love is real.

Throughout weeks of dates, challenges, eliminations and sexy new singles, all in front of our eyes, viewers will get to decide who they want to stay, who they want to boot, and ultimately who they want to crown the hottest couple on Love Island Australia. The winning couple are handed a pot of money to start their new lives together, but there's a catch: one is given the chance to share the money or walk away with it all for them self. Were they after love or money all along?

show.name: Yi Nian Yong Heng
show.summary:
One will to create oceans. One will to summon the mulberry fields.

One will to slaughter countless devils. One will to eradicate innumerable immortals.

Only my will… is eternal.

A Will Eternal tells the tale of Bai Xiaochun, an endearing but exasperating young man who is driven primarily by his fear of death and desire to live forever, but who deeply values friendship and family.

(Source: Novel Updates)

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: The Silent Storm
show.summary: In 1994, tax auditor Ouyang Xu, criminal investigator Yan Ping'an, and Zhou Haiyang—who was searching for his missing wife—met through a counterfeit invoice case in Chunjiang City. Under the tide of the times, the three experienced vastly different circumstances, and their fates gradually diverged. Years later, Operation Grain Rain brings them together again—but the brothers of old now stand on opposite sides. Ouyang Xu faces off against the tax fraud ring led by Zhou Haiyang and the protective umbrella behind it, caught in a painful choice between emotion and the law. Starting from a single invoice, he tears away the veil of greed and ultimately eliminates evil, safeguarding justice.

From that moment on, Qin Nan defies his destiny and begins an upward journey. Along his way, he meets beautiful immortal women, defeats celestial geniuses, and becomes invincible in all battles, eventually becoming a supreme and revered Celestial God.

body.name: Alabama Tornado Super Outbreak
body.summary: On April 27, 2011, a record 62 tornadoes rip through Alabama during the United States' largest ever tornado super outbreak. But one, in Tuscaloosa, proves especially deadly. This tornado is on the ground for 90 minutes, leaving a trail of destruction 80 miles long, as weather reporter Richard desperately tries to get residents to take cover.

show.summary: STAT is a look into the daily lives of staff members at St-Vincent Hospital in Montreal. We discover four longtime friends who work within the same walls and who occupy very different positions. The group of friends is still in shock over the passing of François, Emmanuelle's lover and Philippe's best friend, who died a year earlier in troubling circumstances. Around them is a group of characters who bring the different departments of the hospital to life, in this world that never sleeps.
